# Amged Sayed

> Official developer portfolio of Amged Sayed — Full-Stack Web Developer, Cloud Infrastructure Specialist, and Digital Marketing Strategist based in Cairo, Egypt.

## Projects & Applications

- [Main Portfolio](https://am8ed.site): Official portfolio website featuring technical case studies, skills, and interactive contact.
- [Resume PDF](https://am8ed.site/CV.pdf): Official downloadable CV of Amged Sayed.
- [3atlan Assistance Platform](https://3atlan.am8ed.site): Real-time roadside emergency assistance application built with React, Firebase, and Leaflet Maps.
- [WA-Sender Dispatcher](https://wa-sender.am8ed.site): Automated WhatsApp bulk messaging tool engineered in React 19 and TypeScript.
- [Fursat Safar Travel](https://www.fursatsafar.com): Travel platform frontend and REST API lead generation system.
